title: Intrinsic affine-local flatness implies exact sheaf tensor
statement: Let Y be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and G a quasi-coherent structure-sheaf module [pqf-def-coherent]. If IsFlatOver G (identity Y) [def-pc-scheme-module-flat-over] holds, then G is tensor-flat [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]: the functor tensorRight G on structure-sheaf modules is exact.

proof.text: For each point choose an affine neighbourhood U. Evaluate IsFlatOver G (identity Y) at V = U and U; the identity appLE is the identity on the coordinate ring, so G(U) is flat. Quasi-coherence identifies its localization at the point with the stalk G_x, which is therefore flat over O_Y,x. Tensor commutes with stalks, and exactness of sheaves is detected on stalks. Tensoring any exact sequence with G remains exact on every stalk and hence globally. Tensor is additive and preserves finite colimits; preservation of short exact sequences also gives finite limits, so tensorRight G is exact. If Y is empty the stalkwise test is vacuous; zero stalks are flat.
